name: Tokyo Odi et Amo: Daisawa Romeo
original_name: 東京オディエットアモ　代沢ロミオ編
source:
The heroine, Juli Tengenji, was originally a daughter of an old family, but she fell for some reason and now lives in an apartment with her younger brother.

One Sunday she decides to take on a suspicious extra job, blinded by the high rewards. The part-time job venue was a party held in a privately owned mansion, but it was a "masquerade" held by Romeo Daizawa, a clan sergeant who was a former opponent. .. ..

A neo-Gothic romance simulation game based on "Romeo and Juliet", set in Tokyo and unfolded in just five days.

What is the end of the two people?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6259]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
女主角朱莉·天元寺原本是一个古老家族的女儿，但因为某种原因堕落了，现在和弟弟住在公寓里。

一个周日，她被高额报酬蒙蔽了双眼，决定承担一份可疑的额外工作。打工的地点是在私人宅邸举办的派对，但却是曾经的对手、藩士大泽罗密欧举办的“化装舞会”。……

一款以《罗密欧与朱丽叶》为背景的新哥特式浪漫模拟游戏，以东京为背景，在短短五天内展开。

两个人的结局是什么？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6259]NovelGame[/url]]
